user.title: Sony Legacy (SideView)
user.description: Enter the IP address of your Sony device. The device must be powered on and on the same subnet as Home Assistant. Leave ports at defaults unless your model needs different ones (see README).

pin.title: Enter PIN
pin.description: A PIN should now be displayed on {host}. Enter it below. If nothing appears, power-cycle the device and try again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device. Check the IP, that it is powered on, and that it is on the same subnet.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid PIN. Check the code shown on the device and try again.
